# Vendor

This folder is for third-party JavaScript libraries.

For production, download qrcode.min.js and place it here:
assets/vendor/qrcode.min.js

Then update the script tag in tool pages from CDN to:
<script src="../../assets/vendor/qrcode.min.js" defer></script>

Current CDN used:
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js
